plain: A written contract; once, one that bound a person to work for a set time.

example.quote: It seems to me as absurd, as it would be to say, that I was free and independent, when I had conveyed all my property to another, and was tenant to will to him, and had beside, given an indenture of myself to serve him during life. — The power to keep up standing armies in time of peace, has been justly objected, to this system, as dangerous and improvident.
example.cite: Brutus VIII, New York Journal, Jan. 10, 1788
